source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Billing, coding, credentialing and utilization review, which are administrative functions rather than the core TeamSTEPPS teamwork skills.","B":"Diagnosis, prescribing, surgery and discharge, which are clinical activities rather than the framework's cross-disciplinary teamwork competencies.","C":"Communication, team leadership, situation monitoring and mutual support, which interact to support team performance and patient safety.","D":"Individual speed, hierarchy, competition and secrecy, which conflict with the framework's emphasis on coordinated team performance."}}
source_row.rationale: TeamSTEPPS centers on four teamwork skills—communication, team leadership, situation monitoring and mutual support—used within a defined team structure to improve safety and performance.
source_row.source_detail: TeamSTEPPS framework overview identifies four core teamwork skills: Communication, Team Leadership, Situation Monitoring, and Mutual Support, with team structure central to their use. AHRQ TeamSTEPPS 3.0 current curriculum rechecked 2026-08-15. Reviewed 2026-08-15.
source_row.stem: Which four teamwork skills are central to the AHRQ TeamSTEPPS framework?
